newsitem.title: GREECE: COMMERCIAL BANK/GREECE TAPS INTL MKTS FOR $150MLN.
newsitem.headline: COMMERCIAL BANK/GREECE TAPS INTL MKTS FOR $150MLN.

text.p: State Commercial Bank of Greece borrowed $150 million for about 20 months in international markets at Libor plus 0.125 percent, it said.

"Capitalising on the high quality of its assets and employing modern methods in international money and capital markets, Commercial Bank borrowed $150 million for a period of about 20 months at the lowest cost ever achieved so far in the Greek market," it said.
"The cost of borrowed funds is Libor plus 0.125 percent." --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
